headline: Google's Gemini 4 Argon claims the lead on a finance research test
body: Google released Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier model built for long, complex professional workflows, with a one million token output limit, up from 64,000. Google says the model leads on the Vals Finance Agent v2 benchmark for multi-step financial research, among other domain tests. Introductory API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, rising to $4 and $20 after a promotional period.
note: Labs are now competing on benchmarks built around real analyst work, not just chat quality, which signals where banks and asset managers piloting AI research agents will look next.
